newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA JAN-JULY FOREIGN FUND USAGE UP 15.75 PCT.
newsitem.headline: CHINA JAN-JULY FOREIGN FUND USAGE UP 15.75 PCT.

text.p: China used $26.014 billion in foreign funds in the first seven months of 1997, up 15.75 percent from the year-ago period, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.

China approved applications by 11,487 enterprises to use foreign funds between January and July, down a year-on-year 26.6 percent, Xinhua said, quoting the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation.
The enterprises involved contractual investment of $27.871 billion, down 42.82 percent from the same 1996 period, it said without giving further details.
